digest.overview: Anthropic's detailed position on open-weights models—acknowledging public goods but highlighting risks from Chinese actors—sparked intense debate. Moonshot released full weights for the 2.8T Kimi K3 MoE. Opus 5 user experiments and local model tweaks filled the rest of the short window.

top_story.headline: Anthropic clarifies stance on open-weights models, flags China risks
top_story.summary: Dario Amodei and team state they have never called for a ban but warn that open models without dangerous capabilities are rare; fears focus on military superiority or repression by authoritarian states. HN thread hit 568 points.
top_story.why_it_matters: Direct response to speculation; reshapes policy conversations ahead of potential US voluntary AI framework.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Community split between open-weights advocates calling out competitive fears and safety voices agreeing with guardrail limits; Kimi K3 release adds excitement for accessible frontier weights.

model_releases.headline: Moonshot releases Kimi K3 2.8T MoE weights
model_releases.summary: 2.8 trillion parameter model with native vision and 1M context; 1.56TB download on HF under modified non-commercial license requiring deals above $20M revenue. Includes kernels and agent infra.

frontier_labs.headline: Anthropic position paper on open-weights draws backlash
frontier_labs.summary: Statement emphasizes public-good potential only for safe models while naming China military/repression concerns; TechCrunch and Reddit threads note it as indirect pressure.

influencer_takes.author: Matthew Berman
influencer_takes.quote: They've not advocated for a ban but they have been very vocal about open-source models not being safe... effectively advocating for a ban.
influencer_takes.context: Thread analyzing Anthropic announcement shows how wording lands with open-source community

influencer_takes.author: Nathan Lambert
influencer_takes.quote: Kimi K3 license... distinctly non-commercial, where any company making over $20M/yr must get a specific commercial deal
influencer_takes.context: Highlights practical barriers even in open releases

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: Been reading the weights of the most powerful open weights AI model yet released. Page one starts strong: mostly negatives...
influencer_takes.context: Playful take on Kimi K3 release amid open-weights debate

research_radar.headline: The Burau representation of the braid group is faithful for n=4
research_radar.summary: arXiv math paper on braid group representations; discussed on HN with 26 points.

post_ideas.hook: Anthropic says open weights are fine—as long as they have zero dangerous capabilities
post_ideas.draft: Anthropic's new position: open weights are a public good only if they can't do anything risky. Dario names China as the real fear. Translation: competition is the issue.
post_ideas.why_viral: Directly captures the subtext everyone is arguing about right now

post_ideas.hook: Kimi K3 drops 2.8T weights but the license kills it for most companies
post_ideas.draft: Moonshot just open-sourced a 2.8T frontier model. License: free until you hit $20M revenue, then you need a special deal. Peak 2026 open source.
post_ideas.why_viral: Highlights the gap between 'released weights' and actual usable openness

post_ideas.hook: Matthew Berman nails why Anthropic's 'no ban' statement still feels like a ban push
post_ideas.draft: Matthew Berman: 'They've not advocated for a ban but... effectively advocating for a ban.' The open-weights vs safety debate just got sharper.
post_ideas.why_viral: Puts a popular analyst's precise read on the biggest story of the window
